keyPoints.en: Pathway: nose → pharynx → larynx → trachea → bronchi → bronchioles → alveoli.
keyPoints.bm: Laluan: hidung → farinks → larinks → trakea → bronkus → bronkiol → alveolus.

keyPoints.en: Alveoli: one-cell-thick, moist walls, many capillaries, huge surface area.
keyPoints.bm: Alveolus: dinding setebal satu sel, lembap, banyak kapilari, luas permukaan sangat besar.

keyPoints.en: Inhale: intercostal muscles contract, diaphragm flattens, volume ↑, pressure ↓, air flows in. Exhale: the reverse.
keyPoints.bm: Tarik nafas: otot interkosta mengecut, diafragma mendatar, isi padu ↑, tekanan ↓, udara masuk. Hembus nafas: sebaliknya.

keyPoints.en: O₂ diffuses from alveoli into blood (as oxyhaemoglobin); CO₂ diffuses out.
keyPoints.bm: O₂ meresap dari alveolus ke darah (sebagai oksihemoglobin); CO₂ meresap keluar.

keyPoints.en: Cellular respiration: glucose + oxygen → carbon dioxide + water + energy.
keyPoints.bm: Respirasi sel: glukosa + oksigen → karbon dioksida + air + tenaga.

keyPoints.en: Cigarette smoke: tar (cancer), nicotine (addiction), carbon monoxide (less oxygen carried).
keyPoints.bm: Asap rokok: tar (kanser), nikotin (ketagihan), karbon monoksida (kurang oksigen diangkut).

keyPoints.en: Diseases: asthma, bronchitis, emphysema, lung cancer. Haze and vaping also irritate the airways.
keyPoints.bm: Penyakit: asma, bronkitis, emfisema, kanser peparu. Jerebu dan vape turut merengsa saluran udara.

keyPoints.en: Insects: spiracles and tracheae. Fish: gills. Amphibians: moist skin and lungs.
keyPoints.bm: Serangga: spirakel dan trakea. Ikan: insang. Amfibia: kulit lembap dan peparu.

keyPoints.en: Plants exchange gases through stomata; guard cells open stomata when turgid (usually in light).
keyPoints.bm: Tumbuhan menukar gas melalui stoma; sel pengawal membuka stoma apabila segah (biasanya dalam cahaya).
